project.name: OpenRM Product Requirements
project.description: Controlled system and derived requirements for the OpenRM platform, traced to repository tests, analyses, documentation, and observation evidence.

requirements.title: Controlled requirements management
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall provide tenant-scoped creation, organization, revision, search, comparison, import, and export of controlled requirements with attributable immutable history.

requirements.title: Create and discover requirements
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall create, list, read, paginate, and full-text search project requirements through authenticated APIs and the requirements workspace.

requirements.title: Revise requirements under concurrency control
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall preserve immutable revisions, reject stale expected revisions, and replay idempotent create and revise commands without duplicating controlled state.

requirements.title: Organize requirements with project metadata
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall organize requirements using project folders, tags, typed custom attributes, filters, and owner-scoped saved views.

requirements.title: Interchange controlled requirement data
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall import bounded JSON requirement sets and export the complete current requirement state without bypassing validation, authorization, idempotency, or audit controls.

requirements.title: Tenant isolation and access control
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall authenticate identities, enforce deny-by-default tenant and project authorization, and record attributable evidence for controlled actions.

requirements.title: Authenticate development and production identities
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall support explicit development identities outside production and validate production OIDC issuer, audience, claims, signing algorithm, and signing key.

requirements.title: Enforce tenant and project isolation
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall reject cross-organization and unauthorized cross-project access for every project-scoped read and mutation path.

requirements.title: Enforce distinct project roles
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall enforce distinct administrator, author, reviewer, and viewer permissions and deny actions for unknown roles.

requirements.title: Audit controlled mutations
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall append an immutable tenant- and project-scoped audit event for every controlled mutation with actor, aggregate, event type, payload, and timestamp.

requirements.title: End-to-end traceability and impact analysis
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall maintain directed revision-specific traceability, identify gaps, and propagate attributable suspect impact when upstream requirements change.

requirements.title: Create typed directed relationships
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall create project-configured directed relationship types between compatible artifact types and reject invalid endpoints and self-links.

requirements.title: Enforce relationship cardinality and exact revisions
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall enforce relationship cardinality and preserve the exact immutable source and target revisions represented by each relationship version.

requirements.title: Propagate and resolve suspect impact
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall use a transactional outbox to mark affected downstream relationships suspect and require an attributable reviewer disposition to resolve the impact.

requirements.title: Report trace coverage and gaps
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall expose graph, matrix, coverage, orphan, gap, and suspect-impact queries from the current controlled relationship state.

requirements.title: Controlled change, baselines, and signed evidence
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall create attributable change snapshots and immutable signed baselines that reproduce exact requirement and relationship revisions.

requirements.title: Create attributable changesets
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall snapshot current artifact revisions in ordered changesets and classify added, modified, and unchanged entries relative to the parent snapshot.

requirements.title: Freeze immutable signed baselines
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall freeze exact artifact, relationship, and policy evidence in immutable reviewer-controlled baselines with deterministic manifests, hashes, and signatures.

requirements.title: Compare baseline states
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall compare two baselines and report added, modified, removed, and relationship-changed controlled content.

requirements.title: Export deterministic signed evidence
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall export byte-stable evidence envelopes with manifest hashes, signing metadata, and server-side signature verification state.

requirements.title: Governed review and approval
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall support baseline-bound reviews with independent participants, structured discussion, policy-controlled approval, and signed decisions.

requirements.title: Assemble baseline-bound review packages
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall assemble an attributable review package from one immutable baseline with scope counts, approval threshold, due date, and lifecycle state.

requirements.title: Preserve structured review discussion
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall preserve append-only participants, exact-revision comments, blocking state, resolutions, and lifecycle events.

requirements.title: Enforce approval policy and segregation
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall enforce participant assignment, active review rounds, approval thresholds, blocking-comment policy, and segregation of package and baseline authors from approvers.

requirements.title: Record signed review decisions
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall bind each review decision to the package, baseline, participant, round, actor, decision, and comment using deterministic signed evidence.

requirements.title: Independent requirements verification
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall plan, execute, sign, roll up, and export independent verification evidence against exact baseline requirement revisions.

requirements.title: Plan exact-revision verification cases
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall define immutable verification cases with method, procedure, acceptance criteria, owner, due date, and exact baseline artifact targets.

requirements.title: Enforce independent verification execution
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall allow only the assigned independent review participant to start and complete an attributable verification run.

requirements.title: Record signed results and linked attachments
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall sign each result and preserve a content-addressed attachment manifest containing evidence links, file names, media types, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

requirements.title: Calculate complete verification readiness
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall calculate exact-revision coverage and explainable gate readiness, emit due/completion events, and export complete deterministic gate evidence.

requirements.title: Governed Jira integration
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall deliver governed Jira updates through externally managed credentials, bounded retry behavior, immutable attempts, dead letters, and attributable replay.

requirements.title: Protect connector configuration and credentials
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall store only a fixed external secret reference, require HTTPS connector origins, and construct remote requests only from code-defined Jira paths.

requirements.title: Queue idempotent mapped deliveries
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall validate Jira mappings and payload bounds and enqueue project-scoped deliveries idempotently using stable payload hashes.

requirements.title: Bound retries and dead-letter failures
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall classify remote failures, honor rate-limit guidance, apply bounded backoff, cap attempts, and move exhausted deliveries to a dead-letter state.

requirements.title: Replay connector deliveries with history
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall authorize and attribute replay while retaining ordered append-only configuration events and delivery attempts under tenant isolation.

requirements.title: Measured service operations
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall expose measurable service health, telemetry, queue condition, service-level indicators, dashboards, and actionable alerts for pilot operation.

requirements.title: Expose liveness, readiness, and metrics
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall expose public liveness, database-aware readiness, and Prometheus request, error, latency, delivery, and queue metrics.

requirements.title: Emit structured correlated telemetry
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall emit structured logs, accept W3C trace context, and optionally export spans over OTLP/HTTP to the configured collector.

requirements.title: Report queue and service health
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall provide administrator operations status and provision dashboards and alerts for errors, latency, dead letters, outbox backlog, queue age, and backup condition.

requirements.title: Define pilot service objectives
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall document pilot availability, latency, error, queue, backup-age, recovery, and incident-routing objectives with evidence and escalation expectations.

requirements.title: Secure bounded pilot operation
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall fail closed at trust boundaries, separate secrets from controlled data, reduce exposed attack surface, and document residual pilot risks.

requirements.title: Validate production identity endpoints
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall require clean HTTPS OIDC issuer and JWKS locations, bounded discovery timeouts, approved RSA signing algorithms, and matching issuer and audience claims.

requirements.title: Separate signing and connector secrets
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall load evidence-signing and connector credentials from external configuration, require production-strength signing configuration, and never persist connector tokens.

requirements.title: Harden the HTTP boundary
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall enforce authentication, request-size and time bounds, restrictive CORS behavior, content-security headers, content-type protection, and sensitive-header handling.

requirements.title: Maintain security assurance evidence
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall maintain threat and security reviews, dependency vulnerability gates, remediation evidence, and an explicit independent penetration-test condition before broader regulated exposure.

requirements.title: Usable and accessible product workflows
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall provide coherent responsive workflows that are keyboard operable, browser compatible, and free of automatically detectable WCAG 2 A/AA violations on critical paths.

requirements.title: Expose complete controlled workflows
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall expose live user workflows for requirements, traceability, changesets, baselines, reviews, verification, and Jira operations using the governed API.

requirements.title: Support major browser engines
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall execute critical workflows successfully in current Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browser engines.

requirements.title: Meet automated accessibility gates
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall pass automated WCAG 2 level A and AA scans on requirements, traceability, review, verification, and integration workspaces.

requirements.title: Preserve responsive keyboard-readable presentation
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall preserve semantic structure, readable status, visible focus, keyboard operation, and responsive layouts across the supported product surfaces.

requirements.title: Portable hardened deployment
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall provide a portable production topology whose API runs with least privilege and whose configuration fails closed when required production controls are absent.

requirements.title: Run the API as a hardened container
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall build a bounded API image that runs as a fixed non-root user with a read-only root filesystem, no Linux capabilities, and no-new-privileges.

requirements.title: Provision the production service topology
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall provide a valid production composition for PostgreSQL, API, telemetry collection, Prometheus, Grafana, persistent state, health checks, and external secrets.

requirements.title: Preserve portable service boundaries
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall keep the core deployable with PostgreSQL and configuration-driven adapters while isolating cloud- and provider-specific delivery concerns.

requirements.title: Fail closed on production configuration
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall reject development authentication, insecure identity origins, missing signing identifiers, and insufficient evidence-signing keys in production mode.

requirements.title: Recoverable data and forward-only upgrades
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall back up, restore, verify, and upgrade controlled PostgreSQL state using rehearsed, measurable, forward-only operational procedures.

requirements.title: Create verified PostgreSQL archives
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall create PostgreSQL custom-format archives with attributable metadata using a client compatible with the target server.

requirements.title: Restore and verify controlled evidence
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall restore archives into an isolated database and verify migration count, controlled row count, and presence of critical append-only evidence tables.

requirements.title: Apply idempotent forward-only migrations
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall apply the complete migration set to restored state and prove that a second application produces no drift or destructive rollback.

requirements.title: Document recovery and upgrade operation
requirements.statement: OpenRM shall document backup cadence, retention, restore, upgrade, rollback boundaries, evidence capture, ownership, and environment-specific RPO and RTO acceptance.

verification_cases.title: Automated domain, API, browser, and accessibility verification
verification_cases.procedure: Run the protected OpenRM CI web, API, and database-path jobs. Confirm Rust and web unit tests, authenticated PostgreSQL workflows, tenant isolation, append-only controls, deterministic evidence, connector recovery, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit workflows, and WCAG 2 A/AA scans pass. Inspect the linked source and test evidence by its recorded SHA-256.
verification_cases.acceptance_criteria: All linked automated suites pass with zero failed tests; all targeted requirements are exercised through their controlled API or browser path; dependency audits report no unresolved high or critical vulnerability.
verification_cases.notes: Protected CI and repository-local automated evidence passed for the exact linked files.

verification_cases.title: Operational load, recovery, upgrade, and container verification
verification_cases.procedure: Execute the bounded load and soak harness, PostgreSQL backup/restore rehearsal, forward-only upgrade rehearsal, production topology validation, and clean-volume portable-stack smoke test. Confirm the restored controlled row and migration counts; build the API, bootstrap, and web images; verify all 60 product requirements load; and inspect container user, filesystem, and capability settings.
verification_cases.acceptance_criteria: Load and soak complete within the documented latency/error thresholds; all migrations and critical evidence tables restore; repeated migrations are idempotent; both topologies parse; a fresh portable stack serves the complete OPENRM project; and the API and web images run non-root, read-only, and with all capabilities dropped.
verification_cases.notes: Operational tests passed locally and in the protected recovery-rehearsal and production-artifact jobs.

verification_cases.title: Architecture, security, and operational analysis
verification_cases.procedure: Review the implementation plan, accepted architecture decisions, threat model, security review, deployment boundary, administration guidance, and this controlled requirement catalog. Confirm every targeted requirement is allocated to an implemented boundary and that residual environment conditions are explicit rather than represented as completed repository controls.
verification_cases.acceptance_criteria: Every targeted requirement is supported by an accepted design or operating control; no contradictory architecture decisions exist; security trust boundaries and residual pilot conditions are documented; no unresolved repository launch blocker remains.
verification_cases.notes: Engineering analysis found the repository requirements internally consistent and retained environment commissioning and external assurance as explicit residual conditions.

verification_cases.title: Product and operator evidence observation
verification_cases.procedure: Observe the built product dashboard and controlled workspaces, inspect the browser automation evidence and operator procedures, and confirm the visible Phase 5 state, responsive product surfaces, Jira workflow, review and verification workflows, accessibility status, and pilot operating boundary agree with the controlled requirements.
verification_cases.acceptance_criteria: All targeted product and operating requirements are visibly represented; status and residual conditions are readable and consistent; critical workflows are observable in all three supported browser suites; required operator procedures are present and usable.
verification_cases.notes: Observation and inspection confirmed the implemented product surfaces and operating documentation agree with the controlled requirement baseline.
